scope: Single-flag diagnostic A0/B1/A0 run with the same additional RAF wrappers and frozen game/driver. Independent Page-clock input and shared host mean the realized workloads and external load are not identical. Each frame linked by sampleBefore/sampleAfter and rafIndex, never by equal indices. Timing is Page wall time; no native-entry absolute timestamp. Registered wait requires visible lifecycle, known game parent/callback, intact hooks, active state and explicit unpaused boundaries.

diagnosticMetadata.clock: Page performance.now(); rafTimestamp is the browser supplied frame timestamp, not entry time.
diagnosticMetadata.scope: Existing RAF dispatch and JS/WASM callback boundaries; not physical scanout. pause fields record requested state, not a native state read.
